2609.01182.title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
2609.01182.paper_summary: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live at https://llmpedia.net
2609.01182.paper_summary_zh: 旗艦語言模型在像 MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021) 這樣的基準上似乎已經飽和，得分超過 90% - 然而基準僅測試實驗者想要詢問的內容，這是固定問題集的可用性偏見。LLMPEDIA 使這種偏見可測量且可瀏覽。我們從三個模型家族的參數記憶中遞歸性地實現了約 130 萬篇文章 (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B)，未進行檢索，然後對一個分層樣本的原子主張進行審核，與維基百科和策劃的網絡堆疊進行對比，標記每一個主張是被支持、反駁還是不足 (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026)。在一個均勻隨機樣本中，真實率為 68.4% - 比 MMLU 低超過 21 個百分點 - 其中 30.5% 的主張不足：這些主張是沒有基準探測且世界上最大的百科全書無法裁決的 - 長尾知識或合理的幻覺，證據無法判斷 - 擴展到自由文本，填補了 GPTKB 為三元組建立的覆蓋差距 (Hu et al., 2025)。最終產生的實時開放百科全書讓訪客可以逐一檢查這一前沿，通過五種一鍵查看 - 連結遍歷探索、主張級事實性、跨模型和政治角色比較，以及引導主題深入 - 每個頁面、主張和裁決都有一個穩定的 URL。LLMPEDIA 現在在線上 https://llmpedia.net
2609.01182.author: Muhammed Saeed et.al.
